subject.title: [Feature]: Sessions page: per-row context menu (kebab + right-click) instead of icon-button row

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102564 be the canonical UX direction for Sessions-page row actions, or should this issue be narrowed or folded into a different session-management design?
rationale: The code path is clear, but this is a protected Control UI product/UX change with an open closing PR and overlapping rename/delete trackers, so automation should not choose the permanent interaction model alone.

options.title: Review the linked PR as canonical
options.body: Keep this issue open and use the linked PR to settle the shared menu extraction, action set, guard policy, i18n, and proof before closing.

options.title: Narrow the issue before merge
options.body: Keep the issue open but explicitly remove actions or behavior that maintainers do not want in the Sessions-page row menu.

options.title: Fold into broader session UX work
options.body: Defer the linked PR and track the menu only through a broader session rename/delete issue if maintainers want one larger UX decision.

recommendation.title: Review the linked PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and use the linked PR to settle the shared menu extraction, action set, guard policy, i18n, and proof before closing.
